demo.name: FORM Fitness Club
demo.description: A little stronger. A little closer to your goals. Discover a thoughtfully equipped space for strength training, functional movement, and finding your own rhythm. From your first session to your next personal best, there’s room for you here.

reviewEntries.name: Sara M.
reviewEntries.text: The space feels welcoming from the moment you walk in. I was new to strength training and the coaches helped me build a routine I actually enjoy. The equipment is well maintained, and I never feel rushed during a session.

reviewEntries.name: Amir R.
reviewEntries.text: Thoughtful coaching and a great selection of free weights. My trainer pays attention to technique rather than just adding weight. Early mornings are my favourite time to train here.

reviewEntries.name: Niloofar K.
reviewEntries.text: The classes have such good energy and the changing rooms are clean. It gets busy after work, so I would love a few more evening class options. Still a lovely place to keep a consistent routine.

reviewEntries.name: Reza A.
reviewEntries.text: Enough room to move, friendly people, and a team that remembers your name. The functional training area is a highlight. It feels like a community rather than just somewhere to work out.

reviewEntries.name: Mina S.
reviewEntries.text: I joined to get back into exercise after a long break. Nobody made me feel out of place. The cardio area is bright, and having lockers and showers makes training before work much easier.

reviewEntries.name: Daniyal T.
reviewEntries.text: Solid equipment and helpful staff. The location works well for my commute. A few machines have a wait at peak hours, but the morning sessions are relaxed and the space is always tidy.

highlights.title: Room for every level
highlights.description: A welcoming training floor, whether you are starting out or working towards a new personal best.

highlights.title: Coaching with care
highlights.description: Technique, confidence, and a routine built around your goals.

highlights.title: Make it your routine
highlights.description: Early starts, evening sessions, and space to train at your own pace.

demo.locationDescription: A neighbourhood setting in Jordan, Tehran. Build a workout into your day and explore the surrounding area before your first visit.

owner.name: Arman Rahimi
owner.bio: I started FORM with a simple idea: a training space should make you feel like you belong. Our team brings together thoughtful coaching, good equipment, and a friendly atmosphere so you can focus on making progress at your own pace.
owner.availability: Ask reception about meeting the owner or joining a club introduction.
